dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: Next time, you could try using a soft-bristled brush instead...

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: Yes, something a bit softer than your average wooden comb, better suited to taking care of fur.

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: But some Saurians enjoy being brushed to have their fur groomed, but because it feels like a good old backscratch to them.

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: In such circumstances, you'd be better off using a wide-tooth comb.

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: Trust me, if you're looking to win a grumpy Saurian over, try giving it a brush-down! You never know, it could work wonders.

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: Assuming you can get to the point where you could brush it down, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I give this a go too?

dialogues.speaker: Vilca
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Hmm, I suppose that might work.
